svg.text: The step well (record g28) as the showcase holds it -- top-down
showcase region saved 11-18 12:36Z (ci2 ~/world18full); nothing was dug or placed at the step well after 11-16 16:00Z, so this is its form today
north up; each square = the highest block of its column at or below y 78, darker = lower (number = its y); the rim (ground) is y 62; the tank is dug down in tiers inside the box
-58,70,-74: the bridge dirt over the pit that held the tank (a listed cut of layer y 70)
other solid blocks with air under them above the rim, inside the box + 2 (175: bridge leftovers, hill blocks left over dug cells)
the felling: columns of the record's 50 listed logs (8 trees) -- all gone
the felling's 5 stand cells (obsolete: their trees are gone)
the record's box -65..-43, -85..-63 (W 23, 2 tiers, rim y 62); the circle is the exit
